title: Dataset-size threshold: how few contrastive pairs before a safety steering vector becomes noise?

original_idea.body: Extract a vector from contrastive sets of increasing size with subsampling; locate the stability threshold. Inference-only, bootstrap-centric.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: a size-stability curve prevents over-trusting noisy safety vectors, but catastrophic-risk link is indirect (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Bootstrap/subsample stats with CAA extraction; standard tools, motivated beginner feasible (level 5).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single experiment (size sweep + stability curve) with clear success criterion (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly methodology/reliability contribution on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Dataset-dependence flagged; an explicit size-stability threshold curve may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Dataset effects noted; the size-threshold quantification may be open.
